LOW.label: Low Storage Risk
LOW.recommendation: Suitable for long-term buffer stock storage (3-5 months with proper aeration).

MEDIUM.label: Medium Storage Risk
MEDIUM.recommendation: Short-term storage only. Inspect bi-weekly; prioritize for local regional distribution.

HIGH.label: High Storage Risk
HIGH.recommendation: Do not store in buffer godowns. Dispatch immediately for immediate consumption or processing.

disclaimer: Indicative — based on visible surface defects and rot presence.
